parent.status: user-selected exploratory joint left+front 12000; not a formally qualified R0

branches.ft4: 4 right records, loss sum/6, no old data
branches.er: same 4 right records + 1 left + 1 front from the 64MiB self-contained memory, loss sum/6
branches.full_replay: same 4 right records + 1 left + 1 front from the complete old training split (ceiling, not a memory method)

evaluation_protocol.retry_policy: low scores are never rerun; a run error may be retried once with the original evidence kept

endpoint_rule: Train exactly 12000 updates per branch; never extend, retune or reselect a branch by its scores.

metric_policy.primary: first goal reached and ever-success within 400 steps (equivalent to LIBERO stop-on-success; demos end ~10 frames after success)
metric_policy.secondary: terminal goal at step 400 with ignore_done=True
metric_policy.decided: 2026-10-24 by the researcher; episodes still run the full 400 steps so parent rows stay paired

pseudo_labels.source: parent actions for right-goal training frames under the left/front instructions

method_protocol.comparison_branch_stream: same new-sample, noise and time streams as stage2a s1 (FT4/ER) and stage2b mem001/mem004
method_protocol.hypothesis: CID plus the same 1-frame memory beats ER1 (31/40 substitution, 0/40 success)
method_protocol.mix: each old slot is a pseudo-label or the memory record with probability 1/2
